description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 28.01.2019 to 03.02.2019
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges, and rescinds a previous notification. This content involves regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory instruments related to customs operations, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5).
